messages.content: Find me a documentary about global warming.

function.name: retrieve_scientific_paper
function.description: Fetches the details of scientific research paper based on its topic. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Year of publishing of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the most recent paper

author.description: Author of the research paper. If not specified, fetches the paper with most citations

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have a way to search for films or documentaries directly. The function I have available only retrieves details of scientific research papers. If you’re looking for a scholarly article on global warming instead, let me know and I’ll fetch one for you!
message.reasoning: The user wants a documentary about global warming. We need to use the retrieve_scientific_paper function? That function retrieves details of a scientific research paper, not a documentary. The user didn't specify a year or author. But we can interpret "documentary" as a film, but the tool only fetches papers. There's no function to fetch documentaries. So we cannot fulfill exactly. We should respond that we can't find a documentary because the function only fetches papers. Or we could ask clarifying question. Probably best to ask if they want a scientific paper instead.
